req.title: Reject invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 400 when the status code path segment is not a valid integer.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> must return HTTP 400 when the path segment is not a valid integer. The source code in view_status_code() catches ValueError from int(codes) and returns Response('Invalid status code', status=400). Tests must cover: (1) a valid integer code returns non-400 (positive/EP), (2) a purely alphabetic string returns exactly 400 with correct body (negative/NEG), (3) boundary cases like empty-ish strings, mixed alphanumeric, and comma-separated lists with invalid entries. Mutation resilience requires asserting exact status code 400 (not >=400), exact response body text, and testing both sides of the ValueError branch.

tests.name: test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-015: valid integer path segment must NOT trigger 400 error path
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 400

test_valid_integer_status_code_returns_200()
